recording.note: This is a territory-specific expiry claim, not CC0 or permission from the record company. The 70-year extension did not revive recordings whose earlier term had already expired by 1 November 2013. It does not establish public-domain status in the United States. The same file also carries PD-US-record; that template is a warning about US protection of pre-1972 recordings, not a declaration of US public-domain status.

rights.creditLine: Claude Debussy, La cathédrale engloutie; Marcelle Meyer, piano, Salle Adyar, Paris, 15 February 1956. Les Discophiles Français DF 211/2; source collection: Médiathèque musicale Mahler; Wikimedia Commons. European expiry claim only; US recording rights are not cleared here.
